competitive_position.basis: Stated in Item 1 Business and Item 1A Risk Factors of the FY2026 Form 10-K.
competitive_position.claim: The highly fragmented U.S. and foreign furniture market includes competitors with substantially greater sales volumes, which could restrict Flexsteel's ability to differentiate its products, raise prices, or retain market share.

competitive_position.claim: Most seating products manufactured in Mexico or sourced from Vietnam are subject to a 25% Section 232 tariff scheduled to rise to 30% on January 1, 2027, while Vietnam-sourced casegoods face 10% or 12.5% Section 301 tariffs, risking price disadvantages against less-exposed competitors.

The new framework imposes tariffs of either 10% or 12.5% on imports from certain trading partners, including Vietnam.

Similarly, increases in pricing may have an adverse impact on the competitiveness of the Company’s products relative to other furniture manufacturers with less exposure to the tariff and could also lead to adverse impacts on volume, earnings, and liquidity.
